name: stock.haccp_export

description.en: Raw-fish freezing and traceability (P13, W-STORE). In-house: POST frozen {item, lot, hours, tempC, store?} writes a note on the stock log and answers which EU Regulation 853/2004 Annex III Section VIII rule it meets (-20C/24h or -35C/15h, else null) -- it never blocks a sale. Supplier-treated: the delivery's `treated` paper number. GET /api/owner/stock/haccp?kind=lots|orders|freezing&from=yyyy-mm-dd&to=yyyy-mm-dd (OWNER only; the venue's local days, inclusive, at most 400 days) answers text/csv derived from one replay of the stock log: lot -> orders, order -> lots (each draw's effect on the FEFO lots) and the freezing log. Integer quantities in the supply's base unit; rows recorded before records were dated have an empty date and are always included; text cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with '.
description.uk: Журнал заморожування сирої риби (правила ЄС 853/2004) і CSV-експорт простежуваності партія -> замовлення, замовлення -> партії для інспектора; лише власник.
